property_summary: For any caller, when calling fallback with exactly 10 ether at a strictly later timestamp than the previous call, the reference contract only empties its balance (transfer to caller) on blocks where block.number % 15 == 0; the mutant changes the divisor to 16 so there exist inputs (block.number values) where the mutant transfers but the reference does not (or vice versa).
change_summary: Change modulus divisor from 15 to 16 so transfers occur on different block numbers.
